name: fleet-delivery
description: Delivers a seat's Room inbox and pending job results into the session through the prompt API, one prompt per item, tracked in the plugin's store and logged per seat. Inert until <installRoot>/.aigent/delivery-owner.json says {"owner":{"<seat>":"mod"}}.

installRoot.title: Install root
installRoot.description: Folder holding .aigent/delivery-owner.json, .aigent/state.json and daemons/job-results.mjs; the log and the refresh state are in its memory root. "session": the session's own root. Empty: the mod does nothing.

roomRoot.title: Room root
roomRoot.description: The Room's room/ folder; the seat's inbox is <roomRoot>/inbox/<seat>/. Empty: Room delivery is off.

seat.title: Seat
seat.description: Seat name whose inbox is delivered. Empty: env AIGENT_SEAT, then SEAT, then the session root's folder name with a trailing -vault dropped. Must match [a-z0-9_-]+, else the mod does nothing.

jobSeat.title: Job results seat
jobSeat.description: The one seat job results are delivered to (job records carry no recipient). Empty: job delivery is off.

submitTimeoutMinutes.title: Submit timeout (minutes)
submitTimeoutMinutes.description: How long a submit may wait for its turn to start before it is recorded submitting:unresolved and delivery holds until it settles or is reconciled.

requireRefreshState.title: Require refresh state
requireRefreshState.description: On: a missing, unreadable or invalid <memoryRoot>/runtime/auto-clear-cycle.json holds delivery. Off: a missing one means no refresh cycle on this install.
